purpose: Freeze the finite-difference comparator metric before executable tangent evidence exists.

reference_quantity: [q_bottom(b+delta)-q_bottom(b-delta)]/(2*delta), with both reference trials starting from the identical committed theta state
notes: The 1e-8 denominator floor only defines the scaled-absolute branch of the already precommitted relative-or-scaled-absolute metric.
